description: We are AI/ML & full-stack developers tackling "monitoring health software for astronauts for space mission" challenge. Core focus: Web Dev, AI/ML, Data Analytics & Visualization. Participating to challenge ourselves globally & enhance skills.
summary:
AlphaMedicos is an autonomous astronaut health and wellness monitoring system developed by Team Alpha Bravio (Presenter: Rameen) to address the critical medical challenges of deep space exploration. On lunar and Mars missions, astronauts face a severe 20-minute radio communication delay with Earth, compounded by NASA space hazards such as cosmic radiation, bone density loss, and sleep deprivation.

AlphaMedicos solves this by providing a real-time cockpit telemetry dashboard grounded in official NASA Human Research Program (HRP) thresholds. Key innovations include an AI Flight Surgeon powered by the Google Gemini API with hands-free voice logging, an onboard medical inventory tracker with zero-stock fallback for non-pharmacological cabin remedies, and an interactive 4-4-4-4 box-breathing mini-game for isolation stress relief. It ensures astronaut autonomy and safety beyond Earth.
details:
What It Does & How It WorksAlphaMedicos is an autonomous astronaut health and wellness monitoring platform built for deep space missions. It continuously evaluates vital signs—such as heart rate, cumulative space radiation (mSv), sleep duration, hydration levels, and bone mineral density trends—against official NASA Human Research Program (HRP) physiological thresholds. The system combines a real-time cockpit telemetry dashboard with a 7-day predictive analytics engine and an interactive simulation module, enabling crews to anticipate health risks before they become critical.

Key Features & Creativity

  • AI Flight Surgeon (Gemini API + Voice Control): Allows astronauts to log symptoms hands-free using voice recognition and receive immediate, personalized medical guidance.
  • Zero-Stock Pharmacy Fallback: Tracks onboard medical inventory in real time. If a required medication reaches zero stock, the AI automatically pivots to step-by-step non-pharmacological cabin remedies (such as cold compresses, blue-light adjustments, hydration protocols, and breathing exercises).
  • Calm Mode Mini-Game: Features an interactive 4-4-4-4 box-breathing visual orb designed to lower heart rate and mitigate psychological stress caused by prolonged isolation.
  • Proactive Care Nudges: Delivers timely reminders for hydration, nutrition, and ARED resistance workouts alongside a Ground Control telemetry sync feature.

Benefits & Intended Impact On deep-space journeys to the Moon or Mars, communication delays of up to 20 minutes make real-time medical consultation with Earth impossible, while resupply missions are unavailable. AlphaMedicos bridges this autonomy gap, protecting both physical and mental crew health. Beyond spaceflight, the platform holds strong dual-use value for remote telemedicine, submarine crews, polar research stations, and off-grid healthcare on Earth.

Tools, Languages & Software Used

  • Frontend: React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and Lucide React icons.
  • Backend & Logic: Node.js / Express (server.ts) and a custom TypeScript rules engine (telemetryEngine.ts) grounded in NASA HRP JSON baselines.
  • AI & Voice Integration: Google Gemini API and the browser Web Speech API (SpeechRecognition).

Factors Considered by Our Team Team Alpha Bravio prioritized medical autonomy, finite onboard supplies, hands-free usability in microgravity, and psychological wellness—ensuring astronauts have reliable, zero-clutter medical support even when Earth is millions of miles away.
